direction.drawdown: derive provisional research buffer from historical SET50 benchmark MDD; not a user max or official result

stock_source.expected_panel: partial approved panel; do not call complete SET50 PIT

benchmark_source.interpretation: official TradeSim SET50 benchmark price-index close; exact future scoring feed/revision policy remains unconfirmed

hypotheses.definition: prior 10-observation mean true range / close <= 0.8 * preceding 20-observation mean; close_t > max(high[t-20:t]); volume_t >= 1.5 * mean(volume[t-20:t])
hypotheses.known_at: completed session close; daily source provides date only
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: adjusted next-session open to adjusted close after 5 observed sessions
hypotheses.regime: official SET50 price-index regime descriptive; no current-value proxy

hypotheses.definition: on dates with >=10 approved PIT names, positive adjusted-close 20-observation return in top quintile, conditional on official SET50 close above trailing SMA50 and 20-session index return >=0
hypotheses.known_at: completed session close; daily source provides date only
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: 5-session official-index-relative close-to-close excess return from signal date
hypotheses.regime: official SET50 close above trailing SMA50 and 20-session return >=0

hypotheses.definition: next observed raw open / prior raw close - 1 >= +1% or <= -1%; direction-align post-gap returns
hypotheses.known_at: after the next-session open print; exact time unavailable
hypotheses.primary_control: same-symbol, same-calendar-year non-gap observations; same-date non-gap cross-section separately diagnostic
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: direction-aligned adjusted close-to-close from gap-session close through 5 subsequent observed sessions

hypotheses.definition: volume_t >= 2 * mean(volume[t-20:t]) and adjusted close-to-close return_t > +0.5%
hypotheses.known_at: completed session close; daily source provides date only
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: adjusted next-session open to adjusted close after 5 observed sessions

inference.bootstrap: two-way date/symbol pigeonhole, 10000 replications, seed 20261030, percentile 95% interval
inference.multiplicity: Holm across calculable S3-A/B/C/D primary five-session matched-control mean effects
inference.g1: positive primary matched-control uplift and Holm-adjusted clustered evidence excluding zero; otherwise reject/postpone
inference.g2: chronological slices descriptive only because source data already seen
inference.g3: transaction-cost sensitivity only after g2; do not infer fill probabilities from daily bars
inference.g4: portfolio / position count / TradeSim only after g3

benchmark_risk.market_regime: sign of prior 63 close-to-close returns, ending strictly before the window start
benchmark_risk.note: exploratory only; initial descriptive calculation preceded this freeze; no candidate DD forecast

execution_sensitivity.approximate_v2: no-resting IOC, official tick ladder, one adverse tick, fees/VAT; no volume-cap or fill quantity invented from daily bars
execution_sensitivity.idealized: zero-slippage add-back on fixed prior fills; not portfolio forecast
execution_sensitivity.stress: 1.5x fees and second adverse tick on fixed prior fills; not official
